Commentary.Commentary: We are back! It is time for Australia to show some character with the bat. The Sri Lankan players are in the huddle and they disperse now to take their respective positions. Outwalk the two openers for Australia, David Warner and Usman Khawaja. Kasun Rajitha has a brand new cherry in his hand. Two slips and a gully for him. Here we go...
... Third Innings ...

Sri Lanka on the other hand, have batted brilliantly on what is a tricky pitch and is expected to get tougher from hereon. Almost all the batters were willing to apply themselves and that reflects in the scorecard as four batters notched up the fifties. The stand-out player though was Chandimal as he scored a double ton and has taken his team to a very strong position here. It is also the most number of overs, Sri Lanka have ever faced against Australia in a single innings of a Test match. Can Australia fightback? We will be back with Australia’s second outing with the bat. Stay tuned.

Australia were made to toil hard with the ball and they would have hoped to wrap things up quickly after Lunch. However, they ended up leaking way too many runs and though Starc finished with four wickets, the disappointing part for the Aussies would be that their spinners could not do the job the way everyone expected them to do. It is upto their batters now to bat well and keep their hopes alive in this game.

Sri Lanka have been bowled out for 554 and the home side now have a very formidable lead of 190. What a knock though it has been from Chandimal, notching up his maiden double century and ended up with an extraordinary unbeaten knock of 206! This is the highest score by Sri Lankan against Australia in a Test match as he surpassed Kumar Sangakkara’s 192 at Hobart.

OUT! LBW! Finally, Sri Lanka are dismissed on 554. Tossed up, around off, it spins in. Kasun Rajitha gets on the front foot but defends the wrong line. He gets rapped on the pads and the umpire raises his finger after the appeal. Kasun Rajitha reviews it but that was plumb. The decision stays and Sri Lanka end with a lead of 190 runs.
Tossed up on off. Kasun Rajitha blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter and on off. Chandimal pushes it to covers for a single. Trusting Kasun Rajitha now.
Two! Fuller and on off. Chandimal pushes it to deep extra cover and takes two easily.
Fuller and outside off, turning away. Left alone.
Shorter and outside off. Chandimal blocks it on the off side.
Mitchell Swepson (37-2-100-2) is back into the attack.
On a length and on middle, Kasun Rajitha defends it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, angling in. Kasun Rajitha knocks it mid on.
Pulls back his length again on off, slower too. Dinesh Chandimal pushes it towards point and takes the single.
On a length and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal guides it to deep backward point. He denies the single again.
Back of a length on middle, Dinesh Chandimal defends it down the pitch.
Full and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal knocks it to mid-wicket.
This is not gonna trouble Kasun Rajitha. Starc bowls it full and way outside leg. Kasun Rajitha is happy to let go and Alex Carey does well to stop that diving to his left.
Too full and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal digs it towards third man for a single.
Full toss on off, Dinesh Chandimal drives it through extra cover.

SIX! 200 up for Chandimal. What a way to get to your maiden double century. This is full and in the slot on leg, Dinesh Chandimal clears his back leg and lofts it over the deep mid-wicket fence for another biggie. This has been an incredible innings by him. The crowd in on their feet as they appreciate this magnificient innings.

SIX! Massive hit. This is full and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal hits it through the line and heavs it over long on for a huge six. Moves to 195 now. This is the highest individual score by a Lankan against Australia.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Chandimal. Starc bowls a full toss on leg, Dinesh Chandimal picks this off and smashes it towards deep square leg fence for another boundary.
That was close. Pat Cummins bowls it full and on leg, Kasun Rajitha moves across and tries to play the flick but misses and it goes just past the leg stump.
Bangs it short on middle, angling in. Dinesh Chandimal awkwardly pulls it to the leg side and calls for two, but decides against it, They get one.
Good length on middle and leg, Dinesh Chandimal pushes it with soft hands through mid-wicket and gets a brace.
On a length down the leg, Dinesh Chandimal guides it to fine leg. But again does not take the single.
This is full and on leg, Dinesh Chandimal flicks it through square leg but denies the run.
Back of a length on middle and leg, slower too. Dinesh Chandimal pulls it to deep square leg.
Kasun Rajitha survives. This is a yorker on middle, angling in. Kasun Rajitha digs it out well.
This time he takes the single. Full and on leg, Dinesh Chandimal drills it towards long on for a run.
Full again on leg, Dinesh Chandimal smashes it to wide of long on but refuses the single,
SIX! That is huge. Starc goes full and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal heaves it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
FOUR! Poor delivery. Back of a length down the leg, Dinesh Chandimal tickles it past the keeper for another boundary.
Full and down the leg, Dinesh Chandimal flicks it towards deep mid-wicket.
Good length and outside off, Kasun Rajitha guides it to third man of his outside edge. They don't take the single.
Wide! Good cricket from Sri Lanka. This is on a length way outside off, Dinesh Chandimal offers no shot at it. They run a quick bye and its called a wide too.
SIX! The runs are flowing now. Bangs it short outside off, Dinesh Chandimal makes room and heaves it over covers for a biggie. The lead goes past 150 now.
Full and down the leg side, Dinesh Chandimal glances it down to fine leg and gets a brace.
Good length on top of off stump, Dinesh Chandimal blocks it of his front foot.
On a length on middle, defended down the pitch.
FOUR! Well controlled shot. This is short and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal pulls it hard towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Well controlled shot. This is short and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal pulls it hard towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Kasun Rajitha is the last man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Mitchell Starc cleans him up with a trademark yorker! He comes 'round the wicket and nails a yorker on off. It is too good for Prabath Jayasuriya as he misses it while trying to block it away. The off stump is uprooted and Starc gets his fourth wicket and the lead is now 141. How many more can Sri Lanka get?
Lands on a length, on off. Chandimal drives it to sweeper cover and takes a single.
Starc keeps it full on middle at 128 kph. Chandimal blocks it out.
A fullish delivery on middle. Chandimal swings but gets the bottom of his blade to long on. He denies a single this time.
FOUR! Dinesh Chandimal strikes it firmly and gets a boundary! This is full on middle. Chandimal backs away a bit and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end.
Keeps it a tad short on off. Prabath Jayasuriya defends it solidly off the back foot.
On the shorter side on middle. Prabath Jayasuriya blocks it out. No signs of aggression from Lanka so far.
Goes fuller on off. Prabath Jayasuriya drives it to the cover region.
Back of a length, on off. Prabath Jayasuriya with a solid block from his crease.
Cummins bangs it short on middle and leg. Prabath Jayasuriya ducks under it.
Takes a single off the first delivery of the over! 500 up for Sri Lanka! Back of a length, around off. Chandimal punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
We are back for the post-Lunch session. The players are out in the middle. Dinesh Chandimal and Prabath Jayasuriya to resume the innings. Pat Cummins to bowl now.
...DAY 4, SESSION 2...

Sri Lanka stretch their lead to 135 runs and it has been one exceptional innings from Dinesh Chandimal who is unbeaten on 153! He has been superb for them and is still going strong. The hosts still have two wickets in hand and Sri Lanka will possibly come out with an aggressive intent and look to go past 150. Everything is possible for them as Chandimal is still out there. Will Australia take the two wickets quickly? We will find out soon. Join us back after the break for the second session.

Australia will be a bit of relieved as they have managed to get a couple of wickets but there is still work left to do. Their bowlers failed to break the stand between Dinesh Chandimal and Ramesh Mendis but once the new ball was taken, Mitchell Starc came with his beautiful inswinging yorker to get rid of him. Pat Cummins got one as well but Dinesh Chandimal is standing strong against them and they will look to make early inroads in the second session.
Starc goes for a yorker. However, the length is right but the line is not as it is outside off. Prabath Jayasuriya looks to dig it out but misses. Sri Lanka are 499/8 at Lunch on Day 4!
Lands it a tad short again, around off. Chandimal slaps it without much timing to long off for a single.
On the shorter side on off. Chandimal backs away a bit and swings hard but only gets the bottom of his blade as the ball goes back to the bowler.
Back of a length and around off. Chandimal defends it towards the off side.

This is full and outside off. Chandimal throws his bat at it. However, he gets a thick outside edge that flies over the slip fielders. David Warner is very fine at the third man region and stops it. No single taken.
Back of a length, on middle at 138 kph. Chandimal stays back and defends it towards the leg side.
Lands on a length and it is outside off. Prabath Jayasuriya defends it inside the line of the ball as the ball goes back to the keeper.
Goes a tad fuller on off. Prabath Jayasuriya keeps it out.
Prabath Jayasuriya walks out.

OUT! BOWLED! No, he can't! Pat Cummins destroys the off stump and gets his first wicket of this Test match! Cummins with a good-length delivery, on off. The ball nips away a bit after pitching and beats the forward defence of Maheesh Theekshana. It knocks over the off pole and Maheesh Theekshana after playing a gritty little knock, walks back to the pavilion. Can Australia wrap this innings up quickly now?
Bangs it short but at comfortable height for Chandimal. He pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Three balls remaining in this over, can Maheesh Theekshana survive?
Serves it on a length again, on off at 133 kph. Chandimal knocks it back to the bowler.
Lands on a length, around off. Chandimal looks to push it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads.

Brilliant delivery but equally well played by Maheesh Theekshana! Starc comes charging in from 'round the wicket and spears in a yorker on middle and leg. Maheesh Theekshana though gets his bat down in time.
Bangs it short and around leg. Maheesh Theekshana ducks under it.
Takes a single this time. A shorter-length delivery, around off. Chandimal pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Maheesh Theekshana has to survive two deliveries now.
Back of a length, around off. Chandimal stands tall and punches it to covers.
Lands on a length, swinging into Chandimal at 140 kph. Chandimal hops and looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is a stifled appeal but nothing serious.
Starc lands it short and outside off. Chandimal cuts it to sweeper cover. However, he does not take a single this time.
Fuller and on off. Theekshana blocks it out.
Shorter and on middle. Theekshana sits under it.
FOUR! Theekshana won't mind it! A length ball, outside off. Theekshana opens the face of the bat and guides it to the right of first slip who watches it race into the third man fence.
Length and outside off, it is hit to covers.
A length ball, angling around off, it nips away off the deck. Theekshana looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. The ball is inches away from hitting the off pole.

150 for Dinesh Chandimal! Excellent from him! He has taken his team to a very good position here. It has been a brilliant innings from him! A shorter ball on off. He pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Pat Cummins is back on.
Effort ball from Strac but Theekshana covers it up! A yorker, swinging in, on middle. Theekshana somehow bocks it. Starc throws some words to Theekshana.
Starc tries to swing back in but fails and this goes with the angle outside off. Theekshana looks to drive but misses.
Fuller ball, worked to covers for a single.
A yorker, swinging on off. Dinesh Chandimal blocks it out quickly.
Full again, outside off, this one nips away. Chandimal looks to drive away from the body but misses.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
Slanting on middle, tucked to short leg. Theekshana survives the over.
Tossed up, around off, spinning in. Theekshana prods to defend but gets hit on the pads. It lobs over keeper but the batters don't cross.
Length and angling on middle. Theekshana again blocks it out.
Flatter and spinning around off. Theekshana dances down the track and blocks it out.
Shorter and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
Bye! A loosener! Full and down the leg side. Chandimal fails to flick it away and it rolls to fine leg for a bye.
A length ball, around middle and leg. Theekshana nudges it to square leg for a single.
Tight from Starc! Short of a length, around off. Theekshana thinks to defend but pulls his bat out late.
Pushes it through outside off. Theekshana tries to drive but misses.
A short one, angling outside off. Theekshana is not tempted to play at it.
A length ball, sliding on the pads. Theekshana keeps it out.
This one slides down the leg side. Chandimal fails to flick it away.
FOUR! Second one! Shorter and way outside off. Chandimal gets time to punch it through point for a boundary.
Shorter and spinning on middle. Theekshana hangs back to block it to mid-wicket. A single.
Flatter and around off. Theekshana skips down and fends it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Takes the charge! Tossed up, outside off. Theekshana comes down the track and looks to go over covers but does not connect it well. He does well to clear mid off and the ball races into the fence.
Flatter and outside off. Chandimal punches it to covers for a single. So, Chandimal is trusting Maheesh Theekshana with the bat. Let's see how it goes.
So Australia going with the combination of spin and pace with the new ball. Nathan Lyon comes back into the attack.

NOT OUT! Mitchell Starc bowls it on a length outside off, Maheesh Theekshana tries to drive at it but misses it. The Aussie's appeal for a caught behind and up goes the finger. Maheesh Theekshana does not think that he has nicked this one and takes the review after consulting his partner. The Ultra Edge shows that there is no bat involved. So, the decision will be overturned and Maheesh Theekshana survives and Sri Lanka keep their review.
An inswinger from Starc on middle and leg, Maheesh Theekshana digs it out to mid on.
Full and outside off, Maheesh Theekshana goes for the drive but could not connect.
On a length outside off, angling away, Maheesh Theekshana throws his bat but it just misses his outside edge. Mitchell Marsh looking really good.
Almost action replay. Bowls it full again,swinging in. Maheesh Theekshana misses the ball and gets hit on his pads. It was going down.
Maheesh Theekshana walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! What a start by Mitchell Starc. The new ball does the trick and Australia break this partnership. Mitchell Starc bowls this full on middle, swinging in late. Mendis tries to play at it but gets beaten all ends up and was caught plumb in front. It looks so beautiful on the replay. A lovely inswing-yorker from Starc. Australia had to wait a bit to break the stand and they will now look to take remaining wickets quickly.
The new ball is available now and Australia take it straight away! Can the new ball bring some smiles back in the Aussie camp? Let's find out as Mitchell Starc is back on.
Short and wide on off, Mendis pulls it to long on for one.
Nice delivery. Slower through the air on middle, turning away. Mendis tries to block it but gets an outside edge and the ball runs towards third man. They get two runs.
Full-toss on middle, Dinesh Chandimal smacks it but straight to mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Mendis leans on and blocks it out.
Tossed up on off, Mendis defends it to the off side.
Floated on leg, turning a bit. Dinesh Chandimal works it through mid wicket for a single.

DRINKS! The first hour of the day was critical and it is once again, Sri Lanka who have come out on top at the end of an hour's play. Australia started with the combination of spin and pace but quickly moved to spin from both ends but both the Lankan batters have been at ease and with lead already 109, Sri Lanka are in a very comfortable position here. Aussies need wickets and need them quickly otherwise the game can drift away from them quite quickly. An important hour of play coming up...

Flatter and quicker on leg, Mendis tries to play at it but gets hit on the pads. Shouts for LBW but the umpire is not interested. Perhaps it was going down the leg side. Actually, the replay shows it was going onto hit the stumps. But unfortunately Australia do not have a review. Mitchell Marsh from the pavilion indicates the same during the break.

Floated on middle, Mendis tries to flick it but it goes straight to short leg. They appeal for the catch but the finger stays down. The umpire goes upstairs and the replay shows the ball bounced before going to the fielder.
Tossed up on middle,turning away. Mendis leaves it alone.
Slower through the air on middle, Mendis digs it towards mid on.
Bowls the full-toss again on middle, Dinesh Chandimal drives it to mid off for a single.
Full-toss drifting down the leg, Mendis flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Short again on middle and off, Mendis slaps it to long on for one.
Similar to the previous delivery, Dinesh Chandimal this time cuts it to the right of point and gets the single.
A bit short and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal cuts it straight to backward point.
Floated on middle, Mendis flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle, turning away sharply. Mendis knocks it back to the bowler.
Starts with a full-toss on off, Dinesh Chandimal pushes it through covers for a run.
Full-toss on middle, Dinesh Chandimal eases it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Dinesh Chandimal drives it straight to short extra cover.
A bit short outside off, turning away. Mnedis cuts it from his back foot towards point for a run.
Full and on middle, turning away. Mendis pushes it to the off side.
Floated on middle, blocked towards the bowler.
Tossed up on leg, Mendis knocks it to short mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, around off. Mendis punches it to covers for a single.
Gives it a bit of flight on off. Chandimal skips down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.
On off and fuller. Chandimal flicks it right of the bowler.

Only Marnus Labuschagne is interested there, a loud appeal from him for an LBW! This is outside off and tossed up. Chandimal looks to reverse-sweep it but misses. The ball hits his pads and the impact is outside off.
Tosses this up, around off at 83 kph. Mendis skips down the track and works it to wide of long on for a single.
Flighted delivery, around off. Mendis blocks it off the front foot.
Single to end the over! A fuller one on middle. Mendis works it nicely wide of mid on for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle. Menids drives it to mid on.
Tossed up on middle. Mendis reaches the pitch of the ball and works it towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air on off. Mendis looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge towards the backward point fielder.
Pushed quicker and almost on a yorker length on off. Mendis blocks it out.
A full toss on middle. Chandimal works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Nothing much happening for Australia at the moment, they need to pull their socks here. The lead is already 97!
Goes fuller on off. Menids lets it turns and then blocks it out.
Pulls his length back slightly and it turns into middle. Mendis uses the depth of the crease and works it square off the wicket on the leg side.
Flighted delivery, on off. Mendis defends it towards the leg side.
Bit slower through the air on off. Chandimal sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! This time he connects and gets a boundary! A fuller delivery that drifts on leg. Chandimal paddles it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up! This is also Chandimal's highest score against the Aussies.
Lyon with a flatter delivery, around off. Chandimal looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. However, the impact it outside off as the umpire turns down the appeal.
Much fuller on middle. Mendis defends it off the front foot this time.
Quicker delivery at 92 kph, around off. Mendis blocks it off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle. Chandimal forces it to long on for a single.
Lovely delivery, bit of drift on this one on off. Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Tad shorter and around off. Chandimal chops it to backward point.
Fires it quicker on middle. Chandimal works it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up nicely, around off. Mendis skips down the track and pushes it past Lyon as the mid off fielder cuts it off.
Again the same line on middle. Chandimal nudges it in the gap towards deep square leg for a single.
Turning into middle. Chandimal works it to mid-wicket this time.
Lyon comes 'round the wicket and bowls it flatter on off. Dinesh Chandimal plays it back to the bowler.
Pushed quicker on middle. Mendis works it towards the fine leg region for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Mendis steps down the track and defends it towards the leg side with the turn.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and on middle, worked to mid on for one more.

Just past the fielder! Nicely tossed up, full and outside off. Chandimal leans to defend but it spins away and gets the outside edge but rolls past the diving first slip fielder and to short third man for a single.
Too short and outside off, cut to deep point for one more.
Flatter and outside off, punched to covers.
Floats one full and on middle. Mendis blocks on the leg side.
Mitchell Swepson (32-2-90-2) replaces Mitchell Starc now.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Quicker, fuller and on middle. Mendis stays back and blocks it.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! A flighted ball, full and outside off. Mendis uses his feet and hammers it over mid on and it bounces in front of the fence for a boundary.
Floated ball, outside off. Kept out.
Shorter and outside off, spinning in. Mendis covers his stumps and leaves it.
Short ball to end the over and Chandimal is happy to let it go.
Starc gets a hint of shape here, this one jags in, fuller and on middle, it is drilled to mid on.
Bangs a short one, on off. Chandimal lets it go.
Three runs! Nicely played! Fuller and outside off, angling across. Mendis leans and punches it through covers for three runs.
Full and around middle and leg. Chandimal forces it to the right of mid on for a single.
Length and on off. Defended out.
Fuller and outside off. Chandimal sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Dinesh Chandimal has been hit on the helmet! It is time for the mandatory concussion test. The physio is out and after some inspection, Dinesh Chandimal is ready to go again.

A flatter ball, outside off, this one lands and shoots. Chandimal looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the grills. The ball lobs to the right of short leg. It came off the helmet so a concussion protocal will follow.
FOUR! First boundary of the Day! Tossed up, outside off. Chandimal steps down and across and sweeps it hard to deep square leg where the man dives to his right but fails to stop.
Too full and outside off. Mendis skips down and eases it to long on for one more.
A loopy ball on middle. Chandimal slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tad short and around off. Chandimal sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Another bouncer in the over and Mendis evades it well.
Length and around the 5th stump channel. Mendis gets behind the line to block it.
A bouncer now on middle. Mendis sits under it.
Better from Starc, targeting the pads! This is on a length. Mendis bunts it away to mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off. Chandimal punches it to deep point for a single.
Starc seems to have some issue with his shoe. It's the right one and he has decided to change it now. It seems all good now and we are ready to resume.
A length ball, shaping way outside off. Chandimal shoulders arms to it.
Mitchell Starc (19-2-47-2) will start from the other end.
A loopy ball, outside off. Mendis strides forward and blocks it out.
This one lands on middle and spins on the pads. Mendis nudges it to square leg.
Tossed up, around off. Mendis stays back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full ball, outside off. Chandimal sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Huge spin this time! This lands outside off, fuller and spins in sharply. Chandimal prods across to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Tossed up, around off, hint of spin there. Chandimal tucks it to short leg.

We are all set for Day 4! The Australian players make their way out to the middle. The two overnight batters for Sri Lanka, Dinesh Chandimal and Ramesh Mendis also stride out to resume their innings. Nathan Lyon will start for Australia. Can he provide an early breakthrough? Let's play....

Dinesh Chandimal is up for a chat. He says that it is always special to get a century for country and adds that the wicket was not easy and there was lot of turn at the start of the day. Tells that one needs to be proactive and that is how one can get runs in this kind of pitch. Mentions that they had a plan against Lyon and he tried to be proactive and that’s why he played sweep shots and credits Lyon for the way he bowled. Applauds Kamindu Mendis for his knock on debut and says that he scored quickly as well and that helped team and he has a bright future.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold is near the pitchside. He says there is lot of rough and the ball will spin. It will be key for the bowlers to bowl in that areas. Adds that the batters need to be discipline and bat inside the line.
UPDATE - Pathum Nissanka has tested positive for COVID-19! He won't take any further part in this game. Oshada Fernando will replace him.

It was a tiring day for the bowlers and Australia were feeling a bit exhausted in the end. If they had taken the chances that came towards them, they could probably would be batting right now. Talking about reality, there is some spin on offer on this pitch and Australia will hope to take the remaining four wickets in the first session itself and not allow Sri Lanka to run away with a big lead. Stay tuned for further updates.

Hello everyone! Welcome to the action of Day 4 of this Test match between Sri Lanka and Australia. It’s really hard to say who is on top currently. The hosts have a lead of 67 runs and still have Dinesh Chandimal out there so expect them to continue the good work and stretch the lead around 150. He is unbeaten on 118 and will hope the tail-enders give him a bit of support from the other end.
…Day 4, Session 1…

Right then! Still, a long way to go in this game! Day 4 promises to be a cracker as Sri Lanka will look to extend the lead while Australia will hope to take the remaining four wickets quickly. Join us for the action at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT). Join us early for the build up as well. Till then, Cheers!

Dinesh Chandimal edged one to the keeper and there was a big appeal for it but turned down. He was on some 30-odd runs and Australia were without reviews at that time. Things could have been different if they had one but that is not the case. There were a couple of more LBW appeals and stumping chances as well but none went in the Aussie's favour and due to that, the visitors are slightly behind in this game. Nathan Lyon was the most consistent bowler for them. He bowled more than 50 overs while Swepson too was tight from the other side. The spinners clearly had a say but one can feel, if Alex Carey was more pro-active behind the stumps. They could have been in a better position.

This session saw Dinesh Chandimal getting to his century and Kamindu Mendis, on his debut scoring a fine fifty. Chandimal is still hanging there while Ramesh Mendis has done well to survive the last hour. Sri Lanka are in a good position courtesy of some excellent batting performance.

Sri Lanka started the day trailing 180 runs and they have ended Day 3 with a lead of 67 runs. An excellent batting performance from the hosts. Apart from Nissanka, everyone in the top six went on to score more than fifty. It was a day full of batting with Dinesh Chandimal remaining unbeaten at the end of the Day. He will be very crucial for Sri Lanka on Day 4.
Loopy delivery outside off, Ramesh Mendis pushes it towards covers. That will be STUMPS ON DAY 3.
Full and on middle, Dinesh Chandimal eases it to long on for a single.
Floated on off, blocked towards covers.
Tossed up on middle, turning away. Dinesh Chandimal lets it go to the keeper.

Australia had to grind hard to get the breakthrough. Lyon had a sigh of relief when he came into the attack and saw there was spin on offer. He took the wicket of Mendis early on and after that was consistent as well, creating chances but none went in the Aussie's favor. The bowlers look a bit tired at the end of the session and this break was much-needed for them to come up with a plan to break this partnership. The new ball is relatively new so Australia will look to recharge their batteries and get into the work straight away. Stay tuned as we will be back with the post-Lunch after the break.

Sri Lanka will hope these two continue the good work in the second session and cut the deficit as much as they can.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says there are dark clouds in the background. The pitch is dry and rough. Adds that the ball will come nicely on the bat and he feels there the spinners need to bowl in the right areas to get some assist. The first session will be key for both teams.
Update - 9.53 am IST (4.23 am GMT) - It is raining currently in Galle. Looks like a passing shower. So, the start might be delayed due to rain. Stay tuned for further updates.

Australia on the other hand, will hope the wicket starts doing its bit. It has been good to bat on for the first two days but everyone assumes it to worsen. Also, they would know on such surfaces, a collapse is never far away. The first session can indicate a lot. Stay tuned.

A commendable performance from the Lankan top order has seen them get back into the game. They still though are behind by 180 runs but have 8 wickets in hand. Another spirited show with the bat can see them get into a position to take the lead. Can the likes of Angelo Mathews, Kusal Mendis who will be eyeing a ton and the others come good yet again? Welcome to the coverage.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

The Australians were very disciplined with the ball! They hardly gave anything away to the Lankan batters. They did not get a lot of assistance from the wicket but ensured run scoring was not easy. We believe they under bowled Swepson. He was the one who broke the big stand but he could have been given a lot more overs but maybe they felt the wicket just was not turning enough. They though would hope the wicket starts playing tricks on Day 3 which is also known as the 'moving day' and we could well have an idea of which way this game is turning. Do join us at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT) for all the action. And earlier for the match build-up. Till then, Cheers!

In reply, they did lose Pathum Nissanka early but then came a brilliant partnership between Kusal Mendis and the skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne. The two added 152 with both scoring half tons. Karunaratne fell towards the end of the day but Mathews showed great resilience towards the end of the day and he along with Mendis ensured no more wickets fell. Sri Lanka though still trail by quite a few runs and they will need another partnership if they want to be in a position to take a lead.

Saying that, it has not been easy for the Lankan batters. The Australian bowlers have been very disciplined and hardly have given anything away. ...DAY 2, SESSION 2...

This session still belongs to Australia. They have a huge score on the board, thanks to centuries from Marnus Labuschagne and Steven Smith. Australia had five wickets in hand at the start of Day 2 but no one other than Smith made an impact and they bundled out for 364. Prabath Jayasuriya, on his debut, took six wickets as he was exceptional with the ball while Kasun Rajitha was decent as well. Now, Sri Lanka will hope the openers give a good start and dominate the next session while Lyon and Swepson will be itching to see how this pitch assists them. Do join us for the second session in a bit.

So, Sri Lanka have passed the hurdle by not losing any wickets in the first session. Australia have used both the seamers but it feels the spinners will be straight into the action after the Lunch break.
